root_cause.text: The `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()` function failed to set `VM_DONTEXPAND` and `VM_DONTDUMP` VMA flags, which are required by `drm_gem_mmap_obj()` to avoid a `WARN_ON`, causing a kernel warning when mmap()ing an imported dma-buf from the Apple ISP driver that uses `vb2_dma_sg` memory operations.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "vb2_dma_contig sets VMA flags VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP and I do not see a reason why vb2_dma_sg should behave differently. This avoids hitting `WARN_ON(!(vma->vm_flags & VM_DONTEXPAND));` in `drm_gem_mmap_obj()`". The patch adds `vm_flags_set(vma, VM_DONTEXPAND | VM_DONTDUMP);` to `vb2_dma_sg_mmap()`.
